name: Notion Append Page
job_to_be_done: Append a paragraph block to an existing Notion page so an agent can add notes or results into a workspace page.
short_description: Append a paragraph block to a Notion page.
description: Calls Notion API `PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children` to append a single paragraph block. Requires `NOTION_API_KEY` (integration token) via environment variable.
example_prompts: Append a summary paragraph to my Notion page.
Add this note to the project page in Notion.
